findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 11 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 20 questions numbered 1-20; by section: 11.1 1, 11.1.1 1, 11.1.2 1, 11.1.3 1, 11.2 2, 11.3 3, 11.4 2, 11.4.2 1, 11.4.3 1, 11.4.4 1, 11.5 2, 11.5.1 4.

Main derivations of the unit (domains and ranges of the six functions, even/odd tests, periods of cosine and cotangent by the method of Theorems 11.1 and 11.2) and the main problem types (periods, values by the identities, tables and graphs, maximum/minimum, Ferris wheel, tides, lake reflection). Values are new; every step and result was checked by computation in Python (sympy/numpy). Book corrections followed: 0 < x <= 1 for the secant range; tan(0 + p) = tan 0 in the period proof; with b < 0 the maximum is where the sine or cosine is -1; tan x -> -infinity just right of 90 degrees (Quadrant II).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
